project: Design Bakery — the personal portfolio and engineering site for a fullstack design engineer who builds AI workflow systems.
audience: Hiring managers and technical recruiters evaluating a fullstack design engineer
Engineers and designers reading the case studies and research papers
Prospective collaborators assessing the AI-agent and workflow work
problem: A portfolio that only lists technologies cannot show how a fullstack design engineer actually reasons through AI-agent reliability, adaptive learning, or design systems; reviewers need inspectable evidence, not a skills list.
solution: A Vite/React site with case studies, research papers, and an interactive research-figure renderer, backed by an Express API and Supabase content store, so each project shows its mechanism and its evidence.
mechanism: Static portfolio pages rendered from typed content in frontend/src/app/portfolios/endtoend-engineer/
Case studies under frontend/public/case-studies/ with a shared redirect pattern
Research-paper rendering with figures and tables under frontend/src/app/modules/research/render/
Express API on Railway plus Supabase for published content

evidence.claim: The homepage project cards are driven by a typed, static projects file that records each project's start date and its evidence source.
evidence.supports: Each card carries startedAt and startedAtSource fields, so project ordering is reproducible and every date has a stated source.
evidence.limits: This shows the card data model only; it does not establish that every project description is accurate or current.

evidence.claim: The site defines a single vibrant portfolio palette in one stylesheet that every page consumes through CSS custom properties.
evidence.supports: Named theme variables (theme-pink, theme-yellow, theme-blue, theme-cream, theme-black) are declared once and mapped onto the shared background/foreground/primary/accent tokens.
evidence.limits: It establishes that the palette is centralised; it does not establish contrast compliance for every component.

boundaries: This brief covers the public portfolio site and its published case studies and papers; it does not cover the private operational tooling behind the site.
No claim here asserts hiring outcomes, traffic, or user numbers.
Client or employer work referenced in case studies is described only as far as its public write-up allows.

preferred.case study: a written account of one project's mechanism and evidence
preferred.research paper: a rendered paper with figures and tables under /research
